_comment: Explicit contracts union public org repos advertising deploy-production for both lag and DORA. New apps inherit inventory coverage; until their job/SHA/serving-identity contracts are configured they report unknown, never healthy. prod_job/staging_job are full-match job-name regexes. Target SHA is the FIRST pinned checkout's executed git-log result, not the workflow head or subsequent tooling checkout. To exclude an app, add its full name to exclude.
